verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe self-hosting as a core design goal: run your own relay from the same OSS codebase, a single-node/VPS Compose bundle, and a Helm chart with production (external Postgres/Redis/S3, HA) and quickstart profiles that need no external services. A probe confirms the Helm chart is published on GHCR with versions 0.1.1–0.1.8. Missing for 10: an independent hands-on report of a successful self-hosted deployment.
